summary: Coverage is thin: fetching article pages was blocked, so only search-result snippets with dates in the URL or text were usable. The one fresh, dated item is the 17 Nov 2026 US sell-off, with the S&P 500 down 1.03% to 7,340.53, its lowest close since July, as AI stocks and Nvidia swung lower before Nvidia earnings. Fed policy is hawkish: the October meeting held at 3.75-4% with two votes for a hike, and futures still price a high chance of a hike on 9 Dec. Ahead, Japan CPI and UK retail sales are listed for 20 Nov, and US GDP and PCE for 25 Nov. Nothing dated and verifiable was found for 19 Nov closes, crypto, oil, gold or the other megacaps.
